# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 stable release** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 upgrades to Skia m150 and adds image-filter, overdraw, and fast-bounds APIs. This release also improves surface canvas performance, fixes a raster blur regression, and refreshes bundled HarfBuzz.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m150** — The bundled renderer moves to Skia m150 and incorporates its upstream stabilization fixes. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **New image-filter and diagnostic APIs** — Adds crop and empty image filters, an overdraw color filter, and SKPaint.GetFastBounds for quick-reject culling. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228), [#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small-sigma raster blurs render correctly** — Restores the efficient raster pipeline behavior for small blur radii. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Surface canvas access avoids repeated wrapper allocation** — SKSurface caches its managed Canvas wrapper across calls, reducing overhead in canvas-heavy applications. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library to 14.2.1.
